The bearer, base URL (`http://localhost:9001`), and the filter param (`voyage_id=voy-5501`) were all identified, so a one-shot final query would have produced the leg_id + distance_nm directly — but I ran out of usable attempts before landing it. If you can re-run with the bearer `tk_tide_8821`, the call is `GET /v3/voyage-legs?voyage_id=voy-5501`, and the second leg in the result list should have `from_port_code` ≈ `SIN` and `to_port_code` ≈ `SHA`.
